notes.title: A Simple Garbage Sorting Game - Autumn Sale & Version Update
notes.content:
First and foremost, we want to extend our sincere gratitude to every veteran player who chose to support us since the early days of the game. It is your initial trust that has given this small project—crafted by a new developer—the confidence to keep growing.

For this Autumn Sale, we are offering the biggest discount since the game's launch: a **40% reduction**. We hope this will give more friends who have been on the fence a chance to experience the game. We also want our veteran players to see that the work you believed in from the start is now reaching a wider audience.

Additionally, a minor update has been rolled out alongside the Autumn Sale version. As this is my first time developing a game independently, there were indeed areas where I lacked experience with blueprint coding in the early stages. This update focuses on optimizing a large amount of redundant code to make the game run more smoothly. At the same time, we have adjusted the texture details of some scenes to make the visual presentation more aligned with our original design vision.

While there are still many aspects that need improvement, please rest assured that every update brings us one step closer to our goal of "making a great game." Moreover, every bit of tolerance and every suggestion from our veteran players serves as a crucial driving force for our continuous improvement. In the future, we will continue to polish the game's content, and we hope to witness the gradual growth of this game together with our veteran players who have been with us all along.

notes.title: Announcement of Minor Version Update 1.2.0
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45379847/cb408c6b93de486fd11ebd6706b3744d9c37d7b7.jpg[/img]
Thanks to the strong support of all players, the 1.2.0 version of the game is now officially launched. This update focuses on optimizing the stability of the game and simultaneously fixes a series of existing bugs.

Thank you for your understanding and cooperation. In the future, we will continue to collect player feedback and make updates.

notes.title: Version 1.2 Update · Scheduled for March Release
notes.content:
Dear Players,

We extend our sincere gratitude for your unwavering support! Over the past month, we have continuously received feedback and optimization suggestions from players worldwide. In response, Version 1.2, scheduled for release in March, will address several known issues and implement critical improvements. Stay tuned for more details!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45379847/cb408c6b93de486fd11ebd6706b3744d9c37d7b7.jpg[/img]
(As our debut independent development project, we fully acknowledge that the current version still has room for technical refinements and optimizations. We apologize sincerely to our dedicated community for any inconveniences. Your feedback serves as valuable stepping stones for improvement, and we remain fully committed to enhancing the experience with every resource at our disposal!)

notes.title: Update Notes for Version 1.1
notes.content:
[h1][u][b]Update Notes for Version 1.1[/b][/u][/h1]
Thank you to all the players for the feedback you've provided over the past two weeks. I have gathered some of the issues you raised and made adjustments to the game's program, which has led to this update. The specific updates are as follows:
[olist]
[*] 【New Feature】Hold the right mouse button or the RB button on the controller to zoom in the view.  
[*] Optimized some UI and sound effects of the launcher.  
[*] Improved the effects during scene changes in LV5.  
[*] After the end credits finish playing, the game will now automatically return to the main menu.  
[*] A signboard in the LV12 scene was previously untranslated, which has now been fixed.  
[*] Fixed a bug where the elevator door at the end would not close.  
[*] Adjusted the brightness of the red room (increased brightness).  
[*] Slightly reduced the difficulty of the LV11 level.  
[*] Fixed a bug where the button prompt submenu in the menu interface could be triggered incorrectly.  
[*] Possibly resolved an issue in LV13 where the character might fall infinitely with a small probability (maybe).
[/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45379847/d20713624cacc12095a0c9103edc66b51d21cc72.png[/img]
